QUOTE: `#ifndef MBEDTLS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ACCESS
#define MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(member) private_##member
#else
#define MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(member) member` and "In a default build, a field `flags` is really named `private_flags`." and "Defining `MBEDTLS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ACCESS` makes the macro the identity, so bare `ctx->flags` compiles."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that the macro defaults to private_<member> and that defining MBEDTLS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ACCESS makes it expand to the unchanged member name.
